district: West Sonoma County Union High School District
summary: A Yes vote renews the district's $79-per-parcel tax for eight years, raising about $1,950,000 annually for the district, with an exemption available to seniors.

schools.text: Measure G would provide locally controlled funding for educational programs and services in the West Sonoma County Union High School District.
schools.quote: The measure provides locally controlled funding to support educational programs and services for students in the district.
